statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS identity_migrations (version INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS identity_accounts (username TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, subject_json TEXT NOT NULL, disabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (disabled IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS identity_sessions (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, token_digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, username TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identity_accounts(username), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked_at INTEGER)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS identity_sessions_active ON identity_sessions(token_digest, expires_at)
